g.text: (a) Orbital launch attempts and failures by year from GCAT (J. McDowell, updated 13 October 2026); intervals from Jeffreys priors. (b) Beta(0.9, 1.1) prior with a
mean of 45 %, the reported maiden-flight failure rate (Seradata); orange squares are the reported first- and second-flight failure rates since 1990.
